empirical_protocols.question: Is useful Work quadratic in speed at fixed task and complexity?
empirical_protocols.observable: Matched-process throughput and independently metered physical/useful energy
empirical_protocols.prediction: Conditional exponent2 for T, not necessarily total Q
empirical_protocols.alternative: Fixed overhead, variable efficiency or technology gives another energy-speed curve
empirical_protocols.refutation: Exponent incompatible with2 for independently operationalized T under fixed stated conditions
empirical_protocols.nonconclusion: Only annual GDP/derived energy or different technologies observed

empirical_protocols.question: Does a cost gain reach the transaction price under unchanged absolute profit?
empirical_protocols.observable: Matched product cost, price, margin amount and quality before/after productivity shock
empirical_protocols.prediction: Fixed absolute profit: price reduction equals cost reduction; fixed price: retained gain
empirical_protocols.alternative: Variable markups, demand and quality alter transmission
empirical_protocols.refutation: A violation of the declared branch after observing its fixed variables, not failure of a universal transmission rule never posited here
empirical_protocols.nonconclusion: No product-level cost/price data; no independent shock

empirical_protocols.question: Does repository energy/GDP evidence identify heat→Money transmission?
empirical_protocols.prediction: Conditional proportionality with fixed efficiencies and matched Q/M, not GDP automatically
empirical_protocols.alternative: Common trends, reconstructed energy, changing efficiencies and common causes
empirical_protocols.refutation: Requires independent Q,M and efficiencies; covariance alone does not test the law
empirical_protocols.nonconclusion: Shared construction of energy; GDP is not independently operationalized Money
